from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess, hashlib, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from PIL import Image
d=Path('docs/downsight/golden-d-v2')
p=d/'stereo-fit.png'
ns={'s':'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
v=ET.parse(d/'stereo-fit.svg')
old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','f21dda1:'+str(d/'README.md')],text=True)
block=old.split('```mermaid')[1].split('```')[0]
labels=dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)\["([^"]+)"\]',block))
normalize=lambda s: ''.join(s.split())
for key,label in labels.items():
    group=v.find(f'.//s:g[@id="{key}"]',ns)
    assert normalize(''.join(t.text for t in group.findall('s:text',ns)))==normalize(label)
edge_lines=re.sub(r'\["[^"]+"\]','',block)
expected={a+'-'+b for a,b in re.findall(r'(\w+) --> (\w+)',edge_lines)}
assert {e.attrib['id'] for e in v.findall('.//s:path[@id]',ns)}==expected
for f in [Path('README.md'),d/'README.md']:
    links=re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]*stereo-fit\.png)\)',f.read_text())
    assert len(links)==2 and all((f.parent/url).resolve()==p.resolve() for url in links)
with Image.open(p) as im:
    assert im.format=='PNG' and im.size==(2560,1736) and not im.info
    im.verify()
print('labels:',len(labels),'edges:',len(expected),'README embeds and enlargement links: OK')
print('PNG 2560 x 1736, no text metadata; sha256:',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
